integrity: All general conclusions are supported by a self-contained analytical proof; finite numerical tests are only corroboration. No independent audit or human validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The previously known two-block Fock Toeplitz integral spectrum is explicitly not new; the new claim is the sharp extremal mode staircase, transverse crossings, and large-degree condition ratio for centered bidiscs and a fixed total-degree sector. Results do not extend as stated to arbitrary masks, multiple bands, or degree-dependent radii. Publication priority is provisional.
title: Sharp mode staircase and asymptotic stability for Gaussian concentration on anisotropic bidiscs
